### Cleanest Options by Category

- **Vodka:** Filtered and distilled multiple times, leaving mostly ethanol and water with virtually no congeners, sugar, or carbs. Pairing it with plain soda water and lime keeps sugar and calories low.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7kXhcM43wZ_huYAgAcPWyD_RFqVwoTWDPXht-ey_AbJMemQErua_MY58mTkpuiExujf7vO296Zm2GRbeLACdmCGYFpj3WvlQB0NX_CMNoC8ipXz0rEy7Ttj6xb9pmkLNIQ4dxom-)
- **100% Agave Tequila (Blanco):** Look for "100% agave" and additive-free bottles rather than mixto tequilas or heavily aged dark varieties, which can have added sweeteners, flavorings, or more congeners.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXXCVcjKf1gRjJGFKd65wXjnbusjN6RT0LwlfzRt6GUjCES0R_yOIuQM7RkpiTOcBR_1BMYR8z0RBTgDRho-I1Hc3Hg8VDHX2rSJYJGtOx79JungcOXdZSMLhUGDPCJTX5oLg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF129maoeBFk3rg1l7ZKEfvuL5U5jTTGj_BGWZYDAAf6KyZHBcug8eVmtifwTArjWFTiF9JfafaK0WQB_Y3MyZXNkIdk1uUmsVXdK2pce2WXNTR_iEsoUcQWYxd5jSI77tW6lswU_jjGRPgqxlennylA1jryX24STGvk42Pg9T_0XnqCqxSnFwUlzaLMzZoQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF18PUPQ2xxbtfpux4Zele32sK_VcIGKniKi6yOcQsQO5XwN8Exh0yx8aeDUE6Q3aIVta6U6gzqo7OjFOIcITYT1aYaxsZ8aL40kz9SG4kPozuOJo_sXAemHNH0bzKqV14qxYmPg6q_040NNg8pvBBmSGkUboY-JLrW7rkjCklevHyDL-6I7tsOxn54hyb2hnMjX37hGJOdeiz)
- **Gin:** Similar to vodka in low sugar and calories, though infused with botanicals.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1xB9ukVcoCuBZB4ic6Siyn7HeURiDpJen2dNJdW83z9sI5wRCPTtENlwhDHx8SjhFvdeMBv9WW2EiYK2vcUhO1ZoJK24So9D5UviwsHLiM1TJsrT6bTZ1s80A3SG7BrRvqsTbJOQ7BkPHbO1Phm_Ovi2GXCjZaGgSinr_p-Z)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7kXhcM43wZ_huYAgAcPWyD_RFqVwoTWDPXht-ey_AbJMemQErua_MY58mTkpuiExujf7vO296Zm2GRbeLACdmCGYFpj3WvlQB0NX_CMNoC8ipXz0rEy7Ttj6xb9pmkLNIQ4dxom-)
- **Dry Wines & Brut Champagne:** Lower in sugar than sweet wines or dessert pours, though wine and beer still contain more fermentation byproducts and carbs than clear spirits.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7kXhcM43wZ_huYAgAcPWyD_RFqVwoTWDPXht-ey_AbJMemQErua_MY58mTkpuiExujf7vO296Zm2GRbeLACdmCGYFpj3WvlQB0NX_CMNoC8ipXz0rEy7Ttj6xb9pmkLNIQ4dxom-)

### What Makes an Alcohol "Cleaner"

- **Fewer congeners:** Congeners are chemical byproducts of fermentation and barrel aging (higher in dark liquors like whiskey, bourbon, and dark rum) that are linked to worse hangovers.
- **No added sugar or syrups:** Sugary mixers, tonic water with sugar, and sweet liqueurs add empty calories and spike blood sugar.
- **Simple mixers:** Soda water, club soda, or fresh citrus are cleaner choices than sugary juices or regular sodas.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF19cdhrejkKSMcm_oUZshKxHQGV9KEIltDmc0BfH_qD5Az3c-Fq-PMWtmCekhhhksoRXccDzyhkkrZKWVUjuDG_He1RIzweFDgQ17msGBAN_03DoH0md3Yol7Wa4RF0BM_UMjhKOxHNPg8WwMPk9LoARp5WpHqAcRrMbSLg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXs70LAJS4be9nS4sRfvVKiTvM8jh-fHYMsclSO1B8-IxiVVlHygwPa2of8eq07TElings9nmW8rRp65WMbNJ-9ikFIReU-lhtVXY-xNdSmY3REZq2WBDEupxvPrCzOYjhyaU_2jjZQA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF18PUPQ2xxbtfpux4Zele32sK_VcIGKniKi6yOcQsQO5XwN8Exh0yx8aeDUE6Q3aIVta6U6gzqo7OjFOIcITYT1aYaxsZ8aL40kz9SG4kPozuOJo_sXAemHNH0bzKqV14qxYmPg6q_040NNg8pvBBmSGkUboY-JLrW7rkjCklevHyDL-6I7tsOxn54hyb2hnMjX37hGJOdeiz)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX7kXhcM43wZ_huYAgAcPWyD_RFqVwoTWDPXht-ey_AbJMemQErua_MY58mTkpuiExujf7vO296Zm2GRbeLACdmCGYFpj3WvlQB0NX_CMNoC8ipXz0rEy7Ttj6xb9pmkLNIQ4dxom-)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEBxCJF129maoeBFk3rg1l7ZKEfvuL5U5jTTGj_BGWZYDAAf6KyZHBcug8eVmtifwTArjWFTiF9JfafaK0WQB_Y3MyZXNkIdk1uUmsVXdK2pce2WXNTR_iEsoUcQWYxd5jSI77tW6lswU_jjGRPgqxlennylA1jryX24STGvk42Pg9T_0XnqCqxSnFwUlzaLMzZoQ)

There is a consensus on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF18PUPQ2xxbtfpux4Zele32sK_VcIGKniKi6yOcQsQO5XwN8Exh0yx8aeDUE6Q3aIVta6U6gzqo7OjFOIcITYT1aYaxsZ8aL40kz9SG4kPozuOJo_sXAemHNH0bzKqV14qxYmPg6q_040NNg8pvBBmSGkUboY-JLrW7rkjCklevHyDL-6I7tsOxn54hyb2hnMjX37hGJOdeiz) that clear spirits like vodka and gin are preferable to dark spirits like bourbon, whiskey, or rum because dark liquors often carry added colorings, flavorings, or aging compounds. For score-based comparisons across wine, beer, and spirits, [ZOE](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXfhtu2Uf8_jBRQaMK-MuSdqFNT9FnnQ2SZ3z4s9LKPnnpA1XS_Z-nvOqyYSLKBidxO9TI7CYjlm-GsD_tYaYfROsCgyoFV0tZbVGerIwwrPt-blQ9z1OysOTkQzcg6Q) rates beverages using polyphenol and health scores, while [Medical News Today](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF19cdhrejkKSMcm_oUZshKxHQGV9KEIltDmc0BfH_qD5Az3c-Fq-PMWtmCekhhhksoRXccDzyhkkrZKWVUjuDG_He1RIzweFDgQ17msGBAN_03DoH0md3Yol7Wa4RF0BM_UMjhKOxHNPg8WwMPk9LoARp5WpHqAcRrMbSLg) and [Today](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1xB9ukVcoCuBZB4ic6Siyn7HeURiDpJen2dNJdW83z9sI5wRCPTtENlwhDHx8SjhFvdeMBv9WW2EiYK2vcUhO1ZoJK24So9D5UviwsHLiM1TJsrT6bTZ1s80A3SG7BrRvqsTbJOQ7BkPHbO1Phm_Ovi2GXCjZaGgSinr_p-Z) break down calorie counts, standard serving sizes, and health trade-offs.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXfhtu2Uf8_jBRQaMK-MuSdqFNT9FnnQ2SZ3z4s9LKPnnpA1XS_Z-nvOqyYSLKBidxO9TI7CYjlm-GsD_tYaYfROsCgyoFV0tZbVGerIwwrPt-blQ9z1OysOTkQzcg6Q)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnQEBxCJF18PUPQ2xxbtfpux4Zele32sK_VcIGKniKi6yOcQsQO5XwN8Exh0yx8aeDUE6Q3aIVta6U6gzqo7OjFOIcITYT1aYaxsZ8aL40kz9SG4kPozuOJo_sXAemHNH0bzKqV14qxYmPg6q_040NNg8pvBBmSGkUboY-JLrW7rkjCklevHyDL-6I7tsOxn54hyb2hnMjX37hGJOdeiz)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF19cdhrejkKSMcm_oUZshKxHQGV9KEIltDmc0BfH_qD5Az3c-Fq-PMWtmCekhhhksoRXccDzyhkkrZKWVUjuDG_He1RIzweFDgQ17msGBAN_03DoH0md3Yol7Wa4RF0BM_UMjhKOxHNPg8WwMPk9LoARp5WpHqAcRrMbSLg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESggEBxCJF1xB9ukVcoCuBZB4ic6Siyn7HeURiDpJen2dNJdW83z9sI5wRCPTtENlwhDHx8SjhFvdeMBv9WW2EiYK2vcUhO1ZoJK24So9D5UviwsHLiM1TJsrT6bTZ1s80A3SG7BrRvqsTbJOQ7BkPHbO1Phm_Ovi2GXCjZaGgSinr_p-Z)Are you looking for **low-calorie** or **low-sugar** options, trying to **avoid hangovers** , or shopping for a **specific bottle or mixer** ?
